title: Battle of São Borja (1816)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of São Borja (1816)", at revision 1382589972, opens: "The Battle of São Borja was an engagement which took place in 3 October 1816 during the Portuguese conquest of the Banda Oriental, where forces from Misiones allied to Artigas attempted to attack Portuguese positions in the Misiones Orientales, but were ultimately defeated." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5722870, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1816 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
